## Appearance

Gilbert is a tall, broad-shouldered fellow with curly brown hair, hazel eyes, and a frank face. His expression often features a teasing smile or a clear, straightforward look. At times, he has appeared rather thin and pale, and he retains a very youthful appearance for a doctor.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P50](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0050), [v3 ch.Wedding P12](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0012), [v3 ch.Weddings P22](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0022), [v4 CHAPTER 2 THE HOUSE OF DREAMS P14](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0014)_

## Personality

Gilbert is a clever, good-natured, and kind young man with a sense of humor who can also be teasing. Driven by a determination to get the best out of life, he works hard to earn his own way through college with the ambition to become a doctor. He approaches life with zest and ambition, often working tirelessly to help others.

## History

After spending three years in Alberta with his sick father and a summer visiting cousins in [New Brunswick](../codex/places.md#new-brunswick), Gilbert Blythe returned to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), where he pulled [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) Shirley's braid on his first day back at school, prompting her to break a slate over his head and refuse his apology. Over the next few years, Gilbert maintained a fierce academic rivalry with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) while co-founding the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers) alongside her. He saved her life when her boat began to sink on the pond, and he later gave up the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school contract so that she could take the local teaching job near home. During their time as local teachers, Gilbert and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) put in two years of steady work preparing for college and eventually became close friends. They both attended [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) in [Kingsport](../codex/places.md#kingsport), where Gilbert led the freshman class to victory in the annual Arts Rush. During their time in college, Gilbert proposed marriage to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), but she rejected him, causing a temporary breach in their friendship. Shortly after recovering from a life-threatening bout of typhoid fever, Gilbert proposed to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) once again, and she happily accepted. After their wedding at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), Gilbert carried [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) across the threshold of their new home in [Four Winds Harbor](../codex/places.md#four-winds-harbor) and established his medical practice. When a local man named [Dick Moore](../character/dick-moore.md) lost his memory, Gilbert insisted on pursuing a surgical option that ultimately led to the discovery of the man's true identity as [George Moore](../character/george-moore.md). Gilbert and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) welcomed the birth of their healthy son, James Matthew, though their first child, Joyce, had passed away shortly after birth. Eventually, Gilbert proposed purchasing the [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) place in [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) St. Mary, leading the family to relocate to [Ingleside](../codex/places.md#ingleside), where he continued his work as the town's doctor.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P33](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0033), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A New Interest in Life P0](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0000), +123 more_

## Quotes

> "It wasn’t particularly good of me at all, Anne. I was pleased to be able to do you some small service. Are we going to be friends after this? Have you really forgiven me my old fault?"
>
> — Gilbert Blythe — [v1 CHAPTER XXXVIII. The Bend in the Road P52](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0052)

> "We were born to be good friends, Anne. You’ve thwarted destiny enough. I know we can help each other in many ways. You are going to keep up your studies, aren’t you? So am I. Come, I’m going to walk home with you."
>
> — Gilbert Blythe — [v1 CHAPTER XXXVIII. The Bend in the Road P55](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0055)

> “Not she,” said Gilbert emphatically. “I know Louisa Spencer well. She doesn’t ‘believe’ in Village Improvement Societies, but she does believe in dollars and cents. She’d be more likely to urge Judson on than to dissuade him.”
>
> — Gilbert Blythe — [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P46](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0046)

> "It’s a nice old burg, they tell me, and has the finest natural park in the world. I’ve heard that the scenery in it is magnificent."
>
> — Gilbert Blythe — [v3 ch.Change P22](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0022)

> "You’re just tired, Anne. Come, forget it all and take a walk with me—a ramble back through the woods beyond the marsh. There should be something there I want to show you."
>
> — Gilbert Blythe — [v3 ch.Autumn P15](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0015)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--gilbert-blythe.md)

Gilbert and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) began their relationship as schoolhouse rivals, triggered by Gilbert teasingly calling her 'Carrots' and pulling her braid, which led [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to nurse a long-standing grudge despite his attempts to apologize and even rescue her from a sinking boat. Over time, their fierce academic competition softened as [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) secretly forgave him, and they eventually became close friends, literary collaborators, and romantic partners. They later married and settled together, sharing a life built on years of shared history.

### [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/cornelia-bryant--gilbert-blythe.md)

Miss Cornelia [Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md) is a frequent visitor to Gilbert's household in [Four Winds Harbor](../codex/places.md#four-winds-harbor), becoming a close friend of his family. She often visits to chat and sew, sharing sharp opinions on local matters and neighbors, which Gilbert frequently listens to and chuckles at from his office.
